settings.heading: Started by someone who'd rather be outside.
settings.text:
Peak Side began with a love of being outside and a long-held ambition to build a clothing brand.

It has grown into a community of friends and customers who wear it on the trail, in town and everywhere in between.

settings.question: How long until my order ships?
settings.answer: Orders are typically processed within 2–5 business days. Once it ships you'll get an email with tracking. Delivery time after that depends on your location and the shipping method you choose at checkout.

settings.question: Do you ship outside the US?
settings.answer: Yes. Peak Side ships worldwide. Shipping options, costs and any duties for your country are shown at checkout before you pay.

settings.question: Can I return or exchange something?
settings.answer: Yes, within 30 days of delivery. Items need to be unworn, unwashed, in original condition and with the original tags attached. Sale and final-sale items can't be returned or exchanged.

settings.question: Who pays for return shipping?
settings.answer: Return shipping is paid by the customer, unless the item arrived damaged or defective, or the wrong item was sent.

settings.question: My item arrived damaged or it's the wrong one.
settings.answer: Contact Peak Side within 7 days of delivery with your order number and photos of the item.

settings.question: How do I choose a size?
settings.answer: Every product page shows the piece's cut and any fit note from Peak Side. The fit guide explains how to measure a top you already own. If you're unsure, ask before you order.
